label: ercot117 gas basis probe
definition: (PROBE — rejected, by design) ERCOT-117 gas-basis causal probe: the ercot115 keeper + ercot_thermal_dam_availability_coal (measured coal envelope armed, ERCOT-116 gate protocol) + ercot_zonal_gas_basis=false — a diagnostic ablation restoring consistency between the gas series the offer multipliers were DERIVED against (HH daily − 0.50) and the one dispatch prices them at (EP-anchored, +0.50/+0.41/+0.04 $/MMBtu in 2023/24/25). Never a keeper candidate (it disarms a measured input; rule 14). Result vs the pre-commit (PRECOMMIT-ercot117-gas-basis-probe-2026-07-26): the ranking bias owns the LEVEL, not the season — crossing-band price elevation (+$5.0/+$4.4/+$7.0 in actual-$15–25 hours) drops $3.4/$3.5/$2.0 and coal falls −3.7/−7.3/−2.6 TWh vs the envelope arm (annual ratio 1.06/1.13/1.15 → 1.00/1.01/1.11; C1 16/16), but the matched-band SEASONAL excess does NOT improve vs the envelope arm (10.0→11.2, 12.9→13.8, 13.4→13.7 pp) — P1 refuted: the post-envelope seasonal residual is price-FLAT (+13–19 pp in every band $15→$60+, summer only) and is not a merit-order term. C3a collapses (−40.5/−23.6/−15.7% energy-only) — the EP-anchored gas level is required for price formation; the admissible fix is re-deriving the offer surface ON it (ERCOT-118), not reverting it. Gates: G1 FAIL (2024 −4.7 pp vs −5.0), G2 PASS, G3 FAIL, BITE PASS. Keeper unchanged.
